title: ASM-inspection convention + asm-artefact-present gate
description:
Establish the per-kernel asm-artefact convention so reviewers can confirm SIMD/ILP transforms actually landed.

## Deliverables

1. `dev/scripts/regen-asm.sh <crate> <symbol> <output-path>` — wraps `cargo show-asm -p <crate> --intel <symbol> > <output-path>`. Adds a header comment with crate, symbol, rustc version, target-cpu, and date.
2. Convention: each new SIMD kernel has a sibling `<kernel-name>.asm.txt` artefact in `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/asm/`. (Create the directory.)
3. JIT gate `asm-artefact-present` (auto, postcheck): script checks that any `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/*.rs` modified in HEAD also has its sibling `*.asm.txt` modified in the same commit.
4. Document the convention in `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/README.md` (create if absent).

## Success criteria

- [hard] `dev/scripts/regen-asm.sh` runs `cargo show-asm` successfully on at least one existing SIMD symbol (e.g., `gf2_kernels_simd::x86::avx2::xor_inplace_avx2`).
- [hard] `mcp__jit__jit_gate_define asm-artefact-present` registered with `auto: true, stage: postcheck`.
- [hard] Sample artefact `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/asm/avx2_xor.asm.txt` committed alongside this task to demonstrate the convention.
